facts.fact: The Centre national de presse Norbert Zongo's 2024 digital rights report notes the status quo on the law on access to public information and administrative documents, which it says has fallen into oblivion; it names no repeal and no replacement (no date of the event given, so the document's published date, 2025-02-11, is used).

facts.fact: Burkina Faso's government told UNESCO's 2024 SDG 16.10.2 survey, for the year 2023, that Law No. 051-2015/CNT on the right of access to public information and administrative documents gives the legal guarantee.
facts.system: Loi n°051-2015/CNT portant droit d'accès à l'information publique et aux documents administratifs

facts.fact: The government told UNESCO that the law's oversight is held by the national data protection commission, the national human rights commission, a ministry or agency and the Conseil Supérieur de la Communication, which in 2023 published an annual report, gave guidance and training, raised awareness and kept statistics on requests or appeals.

note: Database record line only; the 2015 law is held.
Statement is on AI imagery and privacy; says nothing on an access to information law.
